acceptance: A CedarDB run bundle carries a non-"unknown" `platform.version` and an edition field (or a recorded reason it is unavailable); a unit test covers the mapping from the server's answer.
The owner's confirmation of the published bundle's edition is recorded in `docs/internal/results-vendor-publication-terms.md`.
context: Filed 2026-11-19 from the remediation of 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-19.
description:
Problem. The published CedarDB bundle `tpch_sf001_cedardb_sql_20260825_095330_cf0d9e4d.json` records `platform.version: "unknown"` and no edition; the adapter (`benchbox/platforms/cedardb.py`, `SELECT version()` into `cedardb_version_string`) does not reach the bundle's version field. The owner's vendor-terms decision D4 (`_project/decisions/vendor-publication-terms-2026-11-19.md`) relies on the Community Edition, which the bundle cannot show, and readers cannot tell which CedarDB release produced a result.
Expected outcome. A new CedarDB bundle records the server version and edition, or states that the edition is not discoverable.

## Decision gate
(agent): establish from a local CedarDB run (the pinned mirror image used by nightly throughput-cedardb) what `SELECT version()` and any licence or edition query return. If no query exposes the edition, stop and ask the owner whether to record the image digest as the edition evidence instead.
Owner gate: the owner confirms the edition of the published bundle; the confirmation is recorded in the terms record (section 1, D4) by the agent.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`, `make agent-write-preflight`); never edit the primary clone.
- No skip, xfail, rerun marker, raised timeout or weakened assertion to turn a check green.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point; no admission or watchdog override.
- No live vendor cloud without owner approval in the task.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (`make comment-policy-check`); user-facing changes add a `changelog.d/` fragment.
- Anchors (file:line, run ids) are orientation from 2026-11-19; re-read before editing and stop to update the item on a mismatch.
- Local container runs use mocker, through `make heavy-run`.
